camada.name: Camada.
camada.description: 3D printing price calculator designed to simplify cost calculations, profit margins, and selling prices.
camada.longDescription:
Camada is a web application developed to help calculate the prices of parts produced with my 3D printers.

The project was designed to simplify the pricing process by considering filament costs, electricity, printing time, and other factors involved in production.

The application also includes features for organizing calculations and tracking suggested prices.

comparadorchaves.name: Key Comparison Tool
comparadorchaves.description: Python desktop application for comparing Brazilian electronic invoice (NF-e) access keys across databases and XML files, identifying discrepancies and simplifying tax document verification.
comparadorchaves.longDescription:
A Python project developed to automate the verification of electronic invoice (NF-e) access keys by comparing records stored in databases with the keys found in XML files.

The application allows users to configure connections to different database management systems, select specific tables and columns, and choose directories containing XML files for processing.

During the comparison process, the system extracts access keys from XML documents, validates their format, and identifies records found in both sources, keys missing from either the database or the files, and possible duplicates.

The application also provides connection testing, configuration saving, secure credential storage, and CSV export of comparison results.

Development involved object-oriented programming, MVVM architecture, the Repository Pattern, integration with multiple database systems, XML file processing, and desktop interface development with PySide6.

The application can be distributed as a standalone Windows executable, allowing it to run without requiring Python to be installed on the computer.

media.alt: Comparison results between the database and XML files

gerenciador-pacientes.name: Patient Management System
gerenciador-pacientes.description: Web application for managing patient records, featuring CRUD operations and an interface built with Vue.js.
gerenciador-pacientes.longDescription:
The Patient Management System is a web application developed with Vue.js to make patient registration and record management easier through an intuitive and functional interface.

The system supports creating, viewing, updating, and deleting records, providing a practical way to manage patient information. Its interface was designed to deliver a simple and organized user experience.

The project also demonstrates fundamental front-end development concepts, including components, data management, reactivity, and CRUD operations using JavaScript, Vue.js, and CSS.

miniblog.name: MiniBlog
miniblog.description: Blog platform built with React, allowing users to create, edit, delete, and search posts. It features user authentication, a rich text editor, and content management integrated with Firebase.
miniblog.longDescription:
A project developed with React and Firebase to create an interactive blogging platform where users can share ideas, experiences, and knowledge through posts.

The application includes user authentication, post management, and a dashboard for organizing created content. It also supports searching posts by title, content, and tags.

The rich text editor provides formatting features for creating more detailed posts, including support for images and tags.

Development involved state management, React Hooks, Context API, navigation with React Router, and integration with Firebase services.

orange-pi.name: Network-wide Ad Blocking & Private DNS Server
orange-pi.description: Network infrastructure project using an Orange Pi Zero 3 as a home DNS server, designed to provide a cleaner browsing experience.
orange-pi.longDescription:
A network infrastructure project using an Orange Pi Zero 3 as a home DNS server, designed to provide cleaner, safer, and more private browsing for all devices connected to the local network. The solution uses Pi-hole to block advertisements, trackers, and unwanted domains at the DNS level, eliminating the need to install blockers individually on each device.

The infrastructure uses Unbound as a local recursive DNS resolver, allowing queries to be made directly through the DNS hierarchy and reducing dependence on public DNS providers. The server runs on Armbian (Linux), with static network configuration and organized services to maintain availability and continuous operation. The project also includes WireGuard for encrypted VPN connections and Nginx for hosting web services and acting as a reverse proxy, depending on the infrastructure configuration.

In addition to software implementation and network service configuration, a custom 3D-printed case was designed to house the Orange Pi Zero 3, providing physical protection, component organization, and adequate ventilation. The project brings together Linux administration, computer networking, security, virtual private networks, DNS, and physical prototyping.

media.alt: Home DNS server interface running on Orange Pi

antigo_portfolio.name: Portfolio 2024
antigo_portfolio.description: My first personal portfolio project, developed to showcase my front-end and back-end development skills.
antigo_portfolio.longDescription:
Portfolio 2024 was my first personal portfolio project, developed to showcase my front-end and back-end development skills by bringing projects, experience, and personal work together on a single platform. The application features a React interface, prioritizing content organization, intuitive navigation, and visual project presentation.

One of its main features is a custom backend built with Node.js and Express, providing a REST API integrated with MongoDB. Through an authentication and content management system, users can create, view, update, and delete projects, making it possible to manage portfolio information without directly modifying the source code.

Development involved REST architecture, state management with Redux Toolkit, data persistence with MongoDB, JWT authentication, and code organization based on development best practices. The project also represents an important stage in my growth as a developer, bringing together programming, interface design, and full application development.

portfolio.name: Portfolio
portfolio.description: Personal portfolio built with Next.js, showcasing projects, professional experience, and technical skills through a modern, responsive, and interactive interface.
portfolio.longDescription:
A project developed with Next.js, React, and TypeScript to showcase my journey as a developer, bringing together projects, professional experience, and technologies used throughout my career.

The application features a homepage organized into different sections, as well as individual pages for each project, allowing visitors to explore their features, technologies, images, and demonstrations. It also supports light and dark themes and provides a fully responsive interface.

One of its key features is the interactive technology section, which allows visitors to see where each tool has been used across the showcased projects. Development focuses on componentization, code reuse, organized architecture, and an intuitive browsing experience.
portfolio.coverAlt: Personal portfolio interface built with Next.js

invest.name: Invest
invest.description: Investment tracking and portfolio management platform focused on the Brazilian financial market.
invest.longDescription:
Invest is an investment tracking and portfolio management platform focused on the Brazilian financial market. Its goal is to centralize information about stocks, real estate investment funds (FIIs), ETFs, and other assets, allowing investors to track their portfolios, check market prices, and monitor investment performance through a modern and intuitive interface.

One of the platform's main features is its personalized price appreciation alert system. The idea is to allow each user to define percentage targets for their assets and receive notifications when a target is reached, making it easier to monitor potential profit-taking opportunities. The platform also plans to include financial dashboards, portfolio allocation charts, transaction history, and performance indicators.

The frontend is being developed with Next.js, React, and TypeScript, with a backend architecture based on NestJS. The project involves componentization, interface state management, financial data visualization, integration with external services, and API development, with an architecture prepared for authentication and data persistence.

impostometro.name: Impostômetro
impostometro.description: Platform designed to help consumers understand how much tax they pay when purchasing products in Brazil, providing greater transparency about the taxes included in product prices.
impostometro.longDescription:
Impostômetro is a web application designed to make information about taxation in Brazil more accessible. It allows users to search for products and view estimated taxes included in their prices.

The goal is to provide a clearer picture of how much of consumers' spending goes toward taxes, helping raise awareness of the tax burden present in everyday purchases in Brazil.

The project is being developed with Next.js, NestJS, MongoDB, Redis, Docker, and Tailwind CSS, combining modern technologies to build an organized, scalable, and user-friendly application.
